name: Inner Wisdom Oracle
license: TO CONFIRM with the artist before this leaves the test branch. Files supplied by the artist for Stellar Tarot; terms of use not yet recorded.
notes: Source card 36 is the artist's credit card (thebarleymoon.ie, Illustrations by the barley moon 2023) and is not a playable card, so it is left out. Card text is the affirmation printed on the card, read by OCR and spot-checked. Card 19 wording to verify against the print.

cards.text: My heart knows its own way.
I need only to focus on right here, right now.
I alone hold the truth of who I am.
All I need is within me right now.
I am constantly growing and evolving.
I let go and I'm at peace.
I hold wisdom beyond knowledge.
I seek out mystery in the ordinary.
I am growing and I am going at my own pace.
I am loved and worthy.
I can rely on the universe to guide me in the right direction.
I deserve to feel joy.
My potential to succeed is limitless.
I release the things that no longer serve me.
I listen to the phases of my life.
I am attuned to the abundance of success.
I am open to receiving unexpected opportunities.
I create the life I desire.
I allow the story of my life to unfold.
I am exactly where I'm meant to be.
I trust my intuition.
I share my light with the world.
My spirit is whole.
I embrace the connection I share with all life on this earth.
I am aligned with the universe.
I am divine.
I allow the universe to work through me.
I listen to my intuition.
I am aligned with love.
All that I need is available to me.
I am doing my best, and that is enough.
I manifest my desires with ease.
I see and feel with clarity.
My higher senses are getting stronger and stronger.
I allow my needs to be met.
